todo_crud.idea: A todo list app with user authentication and task priorities

api_endpoints.description: Register a new user with username, email, and password
Authenticate user and return JWT access token
Retrieve profile of the authenticated user
List all tasks for the authenticated user, sorted by priority
Create a new task with title, description, priority, and optional due date
Retrieve a specific task by its ID
Update an existing task's details, including priority and completion status
Delete a task owned by the authenticated user

plan.description: A web-based todo list application that lets users register, log in, and manage tasks with configurable priority levels. Tasks can be created, edited, deleted, and viewed sorted by priority.
core_features: User registration and secure login
Create tasks with selectable priority (Low, Medium, High)
Edit existing tasks and change their priority
Delete tasks
Dashboard displaying tasks sorted by priority
future_features: Task categories and tags for better organization
Recurring tasks with automatic schedule generation
Sharing tasks or lists with other registered users

milestones: Implement user registration and login with JWT
Create Task CRUD endpoints with priority field
Build React dashboard showing tasks sorted by priority
Integrate SQLite database via SQLAlchemy
Add due date handling and visual indicators
Implement client‑side filtering and sorting by priority and due date
Introduce user settings page for profile updates
Add task categories/tags and UI for tag management
Implement recurring task logic on the backend
Enable task sharing between users with permission controls

todo_crud.idea: A simple todo list app. Users can add, edit, delete, and mark todos complete. Todos have a title, optional description, and done status.

api_endpoints.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users. Supports optional search by email.
Retrieve a single user by its ID.
Create a new user record (admin use). Password must be hashed before storage.
Replace an existing user with new data.
Retrieve a paginated list of the authenticated user's todos. Supports search by title and optional category filter.
Retrieve a single todo belonging to the authenticated user.
Create a new todo for the authenticated user. Title is required; description is optional.
Replace an existing todo with new data (title, description, category).
Delete a todo owned by the authenticated user.
Toggle the 'done' status of a todo owned by the authenticated user.
Register a new user with email and password. Returns a JWT on success.
Authenticate a user and return a JWT token.
Populate the database with demo data (5‑10 records per table).
Return aggregate counts and key metrics for the dashboard (total users, total todos, completed todos).

features: Register and login using email/password, issuing JWTs for session management
Create, read, update, and delete todo items belonging to the authenticated user
Toggle the done status of a todo item
Enforce required title field and proper data types

user_stories.want: to create an account with email and password
acceptance_criteria: POST /auth/register returns 201 with a JWT token when a valid email and password are supplied
Password is stored hashed; the raw password is never returned
Attempting to register with an already‑used email returns a 400 error

user_stories.want: to log in with my credentials
acceptance_criteria: POST /auth/login returns 200 with a JWT token for correct credentials
Invalid email or password returns a 401 error
Token can be used in the Authorization header to access protected endpoints

user_stories.want: to add a new todo item
acceptance_criteria: POST /todos with a non‑empty title returns 201 and the created todo (done defaults to false)
Description field is optional; omitting it does not cause an error
The created todo is linked to the authenticated user's id

user_stories.want: to edit the title or description of an existing todo
acceptance_criteria: PATCH /todos/{id} with any subset of title/description returns 200 and the updated fields
Fields not supplied remain unchanged
Attempting to edit a todo that belongs to another user returns 403

user_stories.want: to toggle a todo's done status
acceptance_criteria: PATCH /todos/{id}/done toggles the boolean 'done' field and returns 200 with the new status
The endpoint only affects the todo owned by the requester; others return 403
The response includes the updated 'done' value

user_stories.want: to delete a todo I no longer need
acceptance_criteria: DELETE /todos/{id} returns 204 on successful deletion
Subsequent GET /todos/{id} returns 404
Deleting a todo owned by another user returns 403

user_stories.want: to view a paginated list of my todos
acceptance_criteria: GET /todos?page=1&size=10 returns a JSON array of up to 10 todos belonging to the user
Response includes total count and current page metadata
Todos from other users are never included in the result set

user_stories.want: to search my todos by keyword
acceptance_criteria: GET /todos?search=keyword returns only todos whose title contains the case‑insensitive keyword
Search works together with pagination parameters
If no todos match, an empty array is returned with a 200 status

non_functional_requirements.authentication: required — each request must include a valid JWT to protect user data
non_functional_requirements.authorization: users can only access, modify, or delete todos that they own
non_functional_requirements.pagination: required on the GET /todos list endpoint

todo_crud.idea: A todo list app with user accounts. Users can register and log in. Each user sees only their own todos. Todos have a title, optional description, due date, priority (low/medium/high), and done/undone

api_endpoints.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users, optionally filtered by username search query.
Retrieve details of a specific user by ID.
Create a new user account with username and password.
Update an existing user's information (e.g., username or password).
Retrieve a list of tasks for the authenticated user, supporting search by title/description and filters for status and priority.
Retrieve details of a specific task by ID.
Create a new task for the authenticated user.
Update an existing task (title, description, due date, priority, completed flag).
Register a new user account (alias of POST /users).
Authenticate a user and return a JWT access token.
Populate the database with demo users, tasks, and priority levels.
Return aggregate statistics such as total users, total tasks, and tasks per priority.

features: Allow users to create an account
Allow users to create new tasks
Allow users to log in to their account

user_stories.want: To register for an account
acceptance_criteria: The user can enter a valid username and password to create an account
The user receives a confirmation message after successfully registering
The user is redirected to the login page after registration

user_stories.want: To log in to my account
acceptance_criteria: The user can enter a valid username and password to log in
The user is redirected to the task list page after successful login
The user sees an error message if the login credentials are invalid

user_stories.want: To create a new task
acceptance_criteria: The user can enter a task title and description
The user can select a due date and priority level for the task
The task is added to the user's task list after creation

user_stories.want: To edit an existing task
acceptance_criteria: The user can select a task to edit
The user can update the task title, description, due date, and priority level
The task is updated in the user's task list after editing

user_stories.want: To delete a task
acceptance_criteria: The user can select a task to delete
The task is removed from the user's task list after deletion
The user is prompted to confirm deletion before it is executed

user_stories.want: To mark a task as complete
acceptance_criteria: The user can select a task to mark as complete
The task is updated to show as completed in the user's task list
The user can filter tasks by completion status

user_stories.want: To filter tasks by status and priority
acceptance_criteria: The user can select a filter option (e.g. 'completed', 'high priority')
The task list is updated to show only tasks that match the selected filter
The user can clear the filter to show all tasks

non_functional_requirements.authentication: required — to ensure only authorized users can access their task list
non_functional_requirements.pagination: not required — task lists are expected to be small
non_functional_requirements.search: not required — tasks can be filtered by status and priority
non_functional_requirements.file_uploads: no — no file uploads are needed
non_functional_requirements.real_time: no — real-time updates are not necessary

blog_cms.idea: A blog with posts, comments, and author profiles

api_endpoints.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token
List users with optional search, status filter, pagination
Retrieve a single user by ID
List posts with search, status and tag filters, pagination
Retrieve a single post by ID
List comments with post filter, status filter, pagination
Retrieve a single comment by ID
Create a new comment or reply
Get recent approved comments for moderation overview
List categories with optional search and pagination
Retrieve a single category by ID
Return aggregate counts and key metrics for dashboard
Global search across posts, comments, and authors with optional type filter
Populate the database with demo data for all tables

plan.description: A modern blogging platform with rich author profiles, organized content, threaded comments, and analytics for authors and editors.
core_features: Author profiles with bio, avatar, social links, and role‑based permissions
Post creation with markdown editor, tagging, scheduled publishing, and draft management
Threaded comment system with moderation workflow (pending, approved, spam) and reply threading
Category and tag taxonomy for organizing posts and enabling filtered discovery
Dashboard showing total posts, comments, active authors, top categories, and recent activity
Global search across posts, comments, and authors with filters for status, date range, and tags
future_features: Like and reaction system for posts and comments
Email newsletter integration for new post notifications
Content recommendation engine based on reader behavior
Multi‑language support and translation workflow
Exportable analytics reports (CSV, PDF)

milestones: Set up FastAPI backend with SQLite and SQLAlchemy models
Implement authentication (login, register, JWT)
Create CRUD APIs for Users, Posts, Comments, and Categories
Basic React UI with routing and pages for login, register, and post list
Rich author profile page with edit capability
Markdown post editor with tag selection and scheduled publishing
Threaded comment UI with moderation controls
Category and tag navigation components
Dashboard analytics (summary stats, recent activity)
Global search endpoint and UI
Advanced filters for posts and comments
Seed data endpoint for demo environment
Responsive design and performance optimizations
Implement like/reaction system
Email newsletter integration
Exportable analytics reports
Multi‑language support

food_restaurant.idea: A recipe manager with ingredients and categories

api_endpoints.description: Return aggregate counts and key metrics for dashboard
Search and list users with optional status filter
Search and list recipes with filters
List shopping lists with status filter

plan.description: A comprehensive recipe management platform that lets users create, organize, and explore recipes, manage ingredients with nutritional data, categorize meals, generate shopping lists, and gain nutrition insights.
core_features: Recipe creation & editing with ingredients, steps, cooking time, servings, and difficulty levels
Ingredient catalog with unit conversion, nutritional information, and pantry stock tracking
Category and tag system for organizing recipes by cuisine, meal type, and dietary restrictions
Advanced search & filter across recipes by name, ingredients, categories, dietary tags, and cooking time
Shopping list generation from selected recipes, consolidating ingredient quantities and units
Nutrition summary dashboard showing average calories, macro distribution, and top nutrient sources across saved recipes
User favorites and personal collections for quick access to preferred recipes
future_features: Meal planning calendar with drag‑and‑drop recipe scheduling
Bulk import/export of recipes via CSV or JSON
Community sharing with public recipe galleries and comments
AI‑powered recipe suggestions based on pantry ingredients
Integration with grocery delivery services

milestones: Implement user authentication and role management
CRUD operations for recipes, ingredients, and categories
Search and filter functionality across recipes and ingredients
Basic shopping list generation from selected recipes
Initial nutrition summary calculations
Nutrition dashboard with macro distribution charts
User favorites and personal collections
Bulk import/export of recipes (CSV/JSON)
Advanced ingredient unit conversion and pantry stock tracking
Public recipe sharing with comments and ratings
AI‑driven recipe suggestions based on pantry contents
Integration with grocery delivery APIs
Performance optimizations and mobile‑responsive UI

api_endpoints.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.
Retrieves the currently authenticated user's profile.
Creates a new counter for the authenticated user.
Retrieves all counters for the authenticated user.
Retrieves a specific counter by ID for the authenticated user.
Increments a specific counter's value by one.
Decrements a specific counter's value by one.
Resets a specific counter's value to zero.
Updates a specific counter's name or value.
Searches counters by name for the authenticated user.
Populates database with realistic demo data.
Returns aggregate counts and key metrics for the dashboard.

features: Allows users to create new counters with a user-defined name, initialized to zero.
Provides a mechanism to increase a counter's value by one.
Provides a mechanism to decrease a counter's value by one.
Allows users to set a specific counter's value back to zero.
Displays all counters created by the user with their current values.
Enables users to remove unwanted counters.

user_stories.want: to create a new counter with a specific name
acceptance_criteria: The user can input a name for the new counter.
Upon creation, the new counter's value is initialized to 0.
The newly created counter is visible in my list of counters.

user_stories.want: to increment a counter's value
acceptance_criteria: Clicking an 'increment' button increases the counter's value by 1.
The displayed value of the counter updates immediately after incrementing.
The incremented value is persisted and remains correct upon refresh.

user_stories.want: to decrement a counter's value
acceptance_criteria: Clicking a 'decrement' button decreases the counter's value by 1.
The displayed value of the counter updates immediately after decrementing.
The decremented value is persisted and remains correct upon refresh.

user_stories.want: to reset a counter's value to zero
acceptance_criteria: There is a clear option to reset a specific counter.
Confirming the reset action sets the counter's value to 0.
The reset value is persisted and remains 0 upon refresh.

user_stories.want: to view all my created counters and their current values
acceptance_criteria: Upon logging in, a list of all my counters is displayed.
Each counter in the list shows its name and current numerical value.
The list is updated to reflect any changes made to individual counters.

user_stories.want: to delete an existing counter
acceptance_criteria: There is a clear option to delete a specific counter.
After confirming deletion, the counter is removed from my list.
The deleted counter is no longer accessible or visible.

non_functional_requirements.authentication: required — Users need to log in to manage their personal counters.
non_functional_requirements.authorization: Users can only view, create, update, and delete their own counters.

out_of_scope: Counter history or logging of changes
Notifications or alerts based on counter values
